from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689809/attempts/82cd395e7c604aefb1723d109802e08f/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # The template is the largest connected component of non-background cells.
    unseen = {(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg}
    components = []
    while unseen:
        start = unseen.pop()
        comp = {start}
        q = [start]
        while q:
            r, c = q.pop()
            for p in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                if p in unseen:
                    unseen.remove(p); comp.add(p); q.append(p)
        components.append(comp)
    template = max(components, key=len)
    r0 = min(r for r,c in template); r1 = max(r for r,c in template)
    c0 = min(c for r,c in template); c1 = max(c for r,c in template)
    # Anchor the template at the middle of its straight-line extent.
    ar, ac = (r0+r1)//2, (c0+c1)//2
    offsets = [(r-ar, c-ac, grid[r][c]) for r,c in template]
    markers = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
               if grid[r][c] != bg and (r,c) not in template]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c in markers:
        out[r][c] = bg
    for r,c in markers:
        for dr,dc,color in offsets:
            rr,cc = r+dr,c+dc
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc] = color
    return out
'''
